blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Nestlé Philippines has collected more than one million sachets since July after deploying machines in select Robinsons Supermarket branches across Metro Manila. The local business of global food and beverage company Nestlé, Robinsons Supermarket, and Restore Solutions PH partnered in May this year to install reverse vending machines.
